description: This Java class defines the Content entity for the sales management system, including fields for content details, descriptions, merchant association, and display properties.

classes.name: Content
classes.description: Entity class representing content items with descriptions, merchant association, visibility, positioning, and grouping attributes.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Returns the unique identifier of the content.

methods.name: setId
methods.description: Sets the unique identifier of the content.

methods.name: getAuditSection
methods.description: Retrieves the audit information for the content.

methods.name: setAuditSection
methods.description: Sets the audit information for the content.

methods.name: getMerchantStore
methods.description: Returns the merchant store associated with the content.

methods.name: setMerchantStore
methods.description: Associates a merchant store with the content.

methods.name: getCode
methods.description: Returns the code identifier for the content.

methods.name: setCode
methods.description: Sets the code identifier for the content.

methods.name: isVisible
methods.description: Checks if the content is visible.

methods.name: setVisible
methods.description: Sets the visibility of the content.

methods.name: getDescriptions
methods.description: Retrieves the list of content descriptions.

methods.name: setDescriptions
methods.description: Sets the list of content descriptions.

methods.name: getContentType
methods.description: Returns the content grouping type (e.g., BOX, SECTION, PAGE).

methods.name: getDescription
methods.description: Returns the first content description if available.

methods.name: setSortOrder
methods.description: Sets the display order of the content.

methods.name: getSortOrder
methods.description: Retrieves the display order of the content.

methods.name: setContentPosition
methods.description: Sets the position of the content (e.g., header, footer).

methods.name: getContentPosition
methods.description: Retrieves the position of the content.
